Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. You can choose to suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon, and it is possible to choose an opponent's Digimon with 5000 DP or less as the target.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's effect to suspend just 1 of my opponent's Digimon when they have 2 Digimon with 5000 DP or less?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon, or 2 of your opponent's Digimon with 5000 DP or less.
